# Known-debt BASELINE for check-money-path-pact-coverage.py — SHRINK-ONLY (issue #8345).
#
# Every entry is a (consumer -> provider) pair where a money_path_services member calls an
# in-repo provider over REST (@RegisterRestClient) and no `pacts/<consumer>-<provider>.json`
# exists. The gate fails on any NEW pair and on any entry whose pair gains a pact, so this
# list can only shrink. Regenerate a candidate list with `--print-baseline`; keep the reasons.
#
# format: <consumer> -> <provider>  # <reason>
openbank-domestic-payment -> openbank-clearing-simulator  # sandbox scheme simulator, not a real counterparty — #8345 says this needs a decision, not a reflex pact
openbank-lending-service -> openbank-analytics-sink  # credit-profile read for offers; no provider replay exists yet — #8345
openbank-sepa-instant -> openbank-clearing-simulator  # sandbox scheme simulator, not a real counterparty — #8345 says this needs a decision, not a reflex pact
openbank-sepa-payment -> openbank-clearing-simulator  # sandbox scheme simulator, not a real counterparty — #8345 says this needs a decision, not a reflex pact
openbank-pension-service -> openbank-domestic-payment  # #12378: a committed pact needs a @PactFolder REST replay in domestic-payment (it has message replays only) and the provider does not yet admit service-account-openbank-pension — both provider-side, #12387
openbank-pension-service -> openbank-sdd-service  # #12378: no @PactFolder provider replay exists in sdd-service and sdd.create/delete deny service-account-openbank-pension — provider-side, #12387
